consumer.detail: a VERIFIED CONFORMANCE package says the run conformed to its frozen plan and protocol; it is not scientific evidence and supports no scientific claim
the package carries no signature: who produced these bytes is not established
World transitions are checked for identity, chaining, admissibility and progression as evidenced; the World's code is not executed by this reader
responses are bound by digest to custody; no model or provider call is repeated
build and plugin-set identities recompute from the execution binding document, whose content is the producer's own statement
gate-2 inputs (coverage, GNDCRW result set) are bound and re-walked as supplied; GNDCRW itself is not re-run
L1 dataset units carry observation digests as the producer attested them

rules.title: manifest closed and canonical-json-1 at rest; schema; plan is a PlanIdentity; members closed, portable unique paths in path order, known roles; limitations a sorted list of unique codes
every member is a regular file inside the root (no link) with the listed SHA-256 and the listed size
no file under the root other than members and MANIFEST-4.json
each member's role is the one its layout place prescribes; evidence and request members are canonical and named by their content digest
package class CONFORMANCE with exactly the CONFORMANCE limitation set; SCIENTIFIC has no manifest-4 semantics and is refused
journal-2: canonical JSONL, no torn tail, sequence 0..n-1, one run, RUN_OPENED at 0 only, no refused / unknown / rejected / failed / aborted event
gate-2 CLEARED for the plan; execution binding, build / plugin-set and AuthorizationIdentity recompute; RUN_OPENED names exactly them

one plan member recomputes the manifest PlanIdentity and holds one closed Protocol IR with its actor / information / proposal / decision / analysis / seed / World / memory / round contracts in closed form

every episode recomputes from plan x authorization x episode_key; steps are rounds x topological order (StepIdentity, RoundIdentity, DAG and schedule identities recomputed); termination verdicts re-derived; completed once
each step carries exactly the commit event its node kind prescribes, after every dependency's commit
proposal / decision / memory identities recompute from their content and are exactly the ones journal-2 commits, at their step and round
custody entries canonical; each accepted call recomputes its CustodyEntryIdentity and names request and response members with the recorded bytes; accepted calls are the actor-call steps

World transitions: transition / intent / state identities recompute; states versioned and chained; admissibility, progression, RNG policy and seed binding as the plan's World contract froze them; each confirmed once

every IR dependency edge is the evidence lineage (call -> proposal -> decision -> World intent -> memory); builtin decision rules recompute; memory lifecycle, cross-episode carry and regime interaction as declared
L1 call bindings: Call / Actor / Role / ExecutionProfile identities, request-2 model / renderer / options / seed, default-deny access trace, upstream and memory observations recompute from the plan
the package holds every evidence role the IR's node kinds require
exactly one conformance attestation, equal to this reader's own re-derivation from the evidence (incl. ERF coverage and the GNDCRW comparison set when the gate bound them)
L1 dataset units equal this reader's own reconstruction byte for byte; a pre-L1 package holds none
the bound analysis output equals this reader's own recomputation over the admitted units (exact rational arithmetic); none when no analysis is bound

external actors (P17): every actor call is answered by the caller its plan declares - a human exchange (consent, request intent, delivery, response) or a tool call (intent, arguments, result) re-derived from its named evidence under the plan's contract; no human / tool record or member is unaccounted for
